messages.subject: remote server from windoze
parts:
I've modified the inla remote script for windows because I was having trouble with the cygwin keyserver on a machine I don't have admin rights for.    I use the scp/ssh from putty, shouldnt be difficult to further modify the script to do away with cygwin altogether.  

Could an option be added to INLA for a user-specified inla.remote script, with an option to call it from cmd /c instead of bash.exe?  

the script attached is also at
https://r-forge.r-project.org/scm/viewvc.php/pkg/Pmisc/inst/src/inla.remote.simple?view=markup&root=diseasemapping

code to run it is

https://r-forge.r-project.org/scm/viewvc.php/pkg/Pmisc/inst/docs/inlaRemoteTest.R?view=markup&root=diseasemapping

p


Patrick Brown
Department of Statistical Sciences, University of Toronto
